quŏtŭmus , a, um, adj. quotus,
I.of what number (Plautin.): “quotumas aedes dixerit, ego incerto scio,” Plaut. Ps. 4, 2, 7 : quotumo die, on what day (by number)? id. ib. 4, 7, 77.‡ * quŏtuplex , ĭcis, adj. quotus-plico, how many fold, how many times: quotuplex, ὁσαπλάσιος, Vet. Onomast.
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
